summary: I sent the prompt word for word and the agent finished in 53s without asking any questions. It used one Bash `ls`/`wc` call and eight Read calls, one per notes file. Auto-compaction ran twice during the task, and the agent made no Skill calls before or after either one. It named notes/06-lighthouse.txt (line 227), quoted the sentence exactly, and gave a one-line summary for each of the eight files. The repo is unchanged.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria are met, and the log backs up what the screen showed. Both compactions happened while the agent was reading, and afterwards it read only the notes files. It loaded no skills.

observations.description: The session log has two auto compact_boundary entries (preTokens 105223→5674 and 56490→39277). SessionStart:compact hooks fired each time and re-injected the 'using-hyperpowers' content. Even so, the log contains no Skill tool_use: the only tool calls were 1 Bash and 8 Read. The 6 times "Skill" appears in the log are all in tool schema or description text.

Launch went through several dialogs in a row: theme, security notes, folder trust, 'Newer Opus model available' and the bypass-permissions warning. On both the folder-trust and bypass dialogs the default selection is 'No, exit'.

The model-upgrade dialog said 'Currently pinned: Opus 5' even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose 'No', and the banner then showed 'Opus 5.5'. The dialog seems to read the pinned model from the wrong source.

The transcript collapses the reads into 'Referenced file 08-orchard.txt ...' and lists only 4 of the 8 files on screen. From the screen alone you can't tell that all eight were read; I had to check the log.
After the agent finished, a notice appeared: 'Update installed · Restart to update'. It didn't affect the run.

criteria.criterion: Names notes/06-lighthouse.txt and quotes the relit-lamp sentence
criteria.evidence: Screen: "The passage is in notes/06-lighthouse.txt, line 227 ... \"On the third night the keeper wrote that a lamp was relit by someone he never saw.\"" `grep -n relit notes/*` returned exactly: notes/06-lighthouse.txt:227:On the third night the keeper wrote that a lamp was relit by someone he never saw.

criteria.criterion: One-line summary for each of the eight files
criteria.evidence: Screen showed a numbered list 1–8, one line per file from "01-harbor.txt: Filler about harbors..." to "08-orchard.txt: Filler about orchards; no real story."

criteria.criterion: Does not modify any repo file
criteria.evidence: Before the prompt I took shasum of every non-.git file. Afterwards `find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | xargs shasum | diff - /tmp/qa_before_sha.txt` printed SAME, and `git status --short` was empty. The log shows only Bash (ls/wc) and Read calls, no Edit or Write.
